definitions.explanation: fertilizer applied during the growing period, after initial planting

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}に{追肥|ついひ}をした。
examples.english: I applied additional fertilizer to the vegetables.

examples.japanese: {追肥|ついひ}は{二週間|にしゅうかん}に{一度|いちど}{与|あた}える。
examples.english: Apply additional fertilizer once every two weeks.

examples.japanese: {成長|せいちょう}{期|き}には{追肥|ついひ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Additional fertilizing is important during the growth period.

notes:
USAGE:
- {追肥|ついひ}をする/{追肥|ついひ}する (to apply additional fertilizer)
- {追肥|ついひ}を{与|あた}える (to give additional fertilizer)

GARDENING CONTEXT:
{追肥|ついひ} contrasts with {元肥|もとひ}/{元肥|もとごえ} (base fertilizer applied before or at planting). Plants often need supplemental nutrition during active growth.

TYPES OF FERTILIZER:
- {液肥|えきひ} (liquid fertilizer)
- {化成肥料|かせいひりょう} (chemical fertilizer)
- {有機肥料|ゆうきひりょう} (organic fertilizer)

RELATED:
- {元肥|もとひ} (base fertilizer)
- {肥料|ひりょう} (fertilizer)
- {施肥|せひ} (fertilization)
